subject: Food Science
title: Food Labeling Requirements
description: A fast breakdown of Food Labeling Requirements for builders.

hook.text: In the 1900s, 'potted meat' could contain anything from horse to sawdust. Food labeling laws ended the guessing game.

buildup.text: Food labels must list ingredients in descending order by weight, nutrition facts, allergens, net weight, and manufacturer details.

discovery.text: Ingredient lists reveal what's inside. 'Sugar' hides as sucrose, dextrose, maltose, or corn syrup to seem less dominant.

twist.text: 'Natural flavoring' can mean over 3,000 different chemicals. The label is legally accurate but practically meaningless.

climax.text: Front-of-pack labels (traffic lights, Nutri-Score) spread globally, simplifying choices for those who skip fine print.

punchline.text: Labels tell the truth—but in a language designed to confuse. Learn to read them.

quiz.question: How are ingredients listed on food labels?
